```yaml
name: i18n-check

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, develop, 'feature/**', 'fix/**' ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, develop ]

jobs:
  i18n-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: 'temurin'
          cache: maven

      - name: Cache Maven dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.m2/repository
            !~/.m2/repository/org/openelis
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-maven-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-maven-

      - name: Install i18n tools
        run: |
          npm install -g i18n-ally-cli || true
          pip install pyyaml || true

      - name: Check for missing translations
        run: |
          echo "Checking for missing translations in OpenELIS-Global-2..."
          
          # Find all properties files
          PROPS_FILES=$(find . -name "*.properties" -type f | grep -E "(messages|i18n|locale)" | head -20)
          
          if [ -z "$PROPS_FILES" ]; then
            echo "No i18n properties files found. Skipping detailed check."
            exit 0
          fi
          
          # Check for consistency across locales
          BASE_FILE=$(echo "$PROPS_FILES" | head -1)
          BASE_LOCALE=$(basename "$BASE_FILE" | sed 's/\.properties$//')
          
          echo "Using base file: $BASE_FILE"
          
          # Extract keys from base file
          grep -E "^[^#].*=" "$BASE_FILE" | cut -d'=' -f1 | sort > /tmp/base_keys.txt
          
          # Check other locale files
          for FILE in $PROPS_FILES; do
            if [ "$FILE" != "$BASE_FILE" ]; then
              LOCALE=$(basename "$FILE" | sed 's/\.properties$//')
              grep -E "^[^#].*=" "$FILE" | cut -d'=' -f1 | sort > /tmp/locale_keys.txt
              
              # Find missing keys
              MISSING=$(comm -23 /tmp/base_keys.txt /tmp/locale_keys.txt)
              if [ -n "$MISSING" ]; then
                echo "WARNING: Missing keys in $LOCALE:"
                echo "$MISSING"
              fi
              
              # Find extra keys
              EXTRA=$(comm -13 /tmp/base_keys.txt /tmp/locale_keys.txt)
              if [ -n "$EXTRA" ]; then
                echo "INFO: Extra keys in $LOCALE (not in base):"
                echo "$EXTRA"
              fi
            fi
          done
          
          echo "i18n check completed."

      - name: Validate message properties format
        run: |
          echo "Validating properties file format..."
          
          ERRORS=0
          for FILE in $(find . -name "*.properties" -type f | grep -E "(messages|i18n|locale)"); do
            # Check for unescaped special characters
            if grep -Pn '[^\\][\n\r]' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; then
              echo "ERROR: Unescaped newline in $FILE"
              ERRORS=$((ERRORS + 1))
            fi
            
            # Check for duplicate keys
            DUPLICATES=$(grep -E "^[^#].*=" "$FILE" | cut -d'=' -f1 | sort | uniq -d)
            if [ -n "$DUPLICATES" ]; then
              echo "ERROR: Duplicate keys in $FILE:"
              echo "$DUPLICATES"
              ERRORS=$((ERRORS + 1))
            fi
          done
          
          if [ $ERRORS -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "Found $ERRORS formatting errors in properties files."
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "Properties file format validation passed."

      - name: Check for hardcoded strings in Java files
        run: |
          echo "Checking for potential hardcoded strings in Java source files..."
          
          # Find Java files in src/main
          JAVA_FILES=$(find . -path "*/src/main/java/*.java" -type f | head -50)
          
          if [ -z "$JAVA_FILES" ]; then
            echo "No Java source files found in src/main/java."
            exit 0
          fi
          
          # Look for common patterns that might indicate hardcoded strings
          # This is a heuristic check and may have false positives
          echo "Scanning for potential hardcoded user-facing strings..."
          
          # Check for string literals in UI-related classes
          for FILE in $JAVA_FILES; do
            # Skip test files and non-UI classes
            if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "(Test|test|util|model|entity|dto)"; then
              continue
            fi
            
            # Look for string literals that might be user-facing
            if grep -nE '(new String\(|\.setText\(|\.setLabel\(|\.setTitle\(|\.setMessage\(|\.addMessage\()' "$FILE" | grep -vE '(//|/\*|\*)' | head -5; then
              echo "  -> Found in $FILE"
            fi
          done
          
          echo "Hardcoded string check completed (informational only)."

      - name: Generate i18n report
        run: |
          echo "Generating i18n coverage report..."
          
          REPORT_FILE="i18n-report.md"
          echo "# i18n Coverage Report" > "$REPORT_FILE"
          echo "" >> "$REPORT_FILE"
          echo "Generated on: $(date -u)" >> "$REPORT_FILE"
          echo "" >> "$REPORT_FILE"
          
          # Count properties files
          PROPS_COUNT=$(find . -name "*.properties" -type f | grep -E "(messages|i18n|locale)" | wc -l)
          echo "## Summary" >> "$REPORT_FILE"
          echo "- Total i18n properties files: $PROPS_COUNT" >> "$REPORT_FILE"
          echo "" >> "$REPORT_FILE"
          
          # List all locale files
          echo "## Locale Files" >> "$REPORT_FILE"
          find . -name "*.properties" -type f | grep -E "(messages|i18n|locale)" | while read FILE; do
            echo "- \`$FILE\`" >> "$REPORT_FILE"
          done
          echo "" >> "$REPORT_FILE"
          
          # Check for empty translations
          echo "## Empty Translations Check" >> "$REPORT_FILE"
          for FILE in $(find . -name "*.properties" -type f | grep -E "(messages|i18n|locale)"); do
            EMPTY_KEYS=$(grep -E "^[^#].*=$" "$FILE" | cut -d'=' -f1)
            if [ -n "$EMPTY_KEYS" ]; then
              echo "### $FILE" >> "$REPORT_FILE"
              echo "The following keys have empty values:" >> "$REPORT_FILE"
              echo '```' >> "$REPORT_FILE"
              echo "$EMPTY_KEYS" >> "$REPORT_FILE"
              echo '```' >> "$REPORT_FILE"
              echo "" >> "$REPORT_FILE"
            fi
          done
          
          cat "$REPORT_FILE"
          
          # Upload report as artifact
          echo "Uploading i18n report..."

      - name: Upload i18n report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: i18n-report
          path: i18n-report.md
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Comment on PR if i18n issues found
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: |
          # This step would typically use a GitHub API call to comment on the PR
          # For now, we just output the message
          echo "If i18n issues were found, a comment would be added to the PR."
          echo "This requires the GITHUB_TOKEN with appropriate permissions."
